npcs.name: CH 3-6 E Plaza Challenger 5
npcs.meet_text: I've been watching everyone play all day.
npcs.repeat_text: if you're going to try it then good luck!!!

npcs.name: CH 3-6 E Plaza Challenger 6
npcs.meet_text: I thought I was too old to be good at this, but the elders are amazing and have been playing all day long.
npcs.repeat_text: If you win then maybe you can teach me how to play.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 E Old Guy Neighbour
npcs.meet_text: It's been a long day for sure. While I was doing my shopping earlier I tried my luck at the Holo Rare Stand. Of course I don't actually collect any cards or play it so you can have the card I won.
npcs.repeat_text: I only decided to try my luck for the fun of it, it was such a thrill!

npcs.name: CH 3-5 D,E Psychic Brienne
npcs.meet_text: The SS Anne has ruined my daily meditation so I've had to try a new spot today.
npcs.repeat_text: It's not quite as good of a spot as the dock is but here but it's still peaceful enough.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 D,E Holo Rare Shopkeeper
npcs.meet_text: Welcome! I deal in mystery Holo Rares. Seven types, one pick — pay $400 and find out what fate has in store for you!

npcs.name: CH 3-6 D,E Coin Shopkeeper
npcs.meet_text: Welcome! I sell rare limited edition coins that you won't be able to buy anywhere else! They're not cheap at $300 each but I promise you they're top quality, completely unique and won't find anything like them around!

npcs.name: CH 3-6 D,E Fruit And Veg Shopkeeper
npcs.meet_text: Hello - fresh fruit and veg for sale here. We've got everything you could ask for.
npcs.repeat_text: I've got some discounted fruit on offer if you're interested.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 D,E Bakery Shopkeeper
npcs.meet_text: Get your freshly baked pastries, cakes and bread all here.
npcs.repeat_text: Plenty of items still fresh to enjoy!

npcs.name: CH 3-6 E Bakery Lover
npcs.meet_text: I LOVE FRESH BREAD! It's always so warm and crispy if you get it here early enough. If you're here that must mean you love it as much as I do!! We should be best friends!!
npcs.repeat_text: I got so hungry from before that I just had to come back and get some more bread. It's soooo good.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 E Brock
npcs.meet_text: Hey I'm Brock. I used to be a Gym Leader a long time ago. Battling wasn't for me so I gave it up to become a Pokemon Breeder and travel the world. Have this card of my favourite Pokemon.
npcs.repeat_text: I much prefer to play the TCG than battling so I'm looking forward to the challenge.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 D,E Sunbathing Sailor 1
npcs.meet_text: I got nothing to do until tonight so I'm taking it easy.
npcs.repeat_text: I aint doing work if I aint being paid for it.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 D,E Sailor Working On SS Anne
npcs.meet_text: The SS Anne will be sailing for a long time.
npcs.repeat_text: It only makes it's trip once a year so there's a lot of work to be done when it sails.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 E Sunbathing Sailor 2
npcs.meet_text: Misty left and I didn't say hello. I have to head back to the Anne so I won't have chance now.
npcs.repeat_text: Weird how life works. You never know who you're going to run into years down the line.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 E Worker On Dock
npcs.meet_text: I'll be done with this work very soon, I'm just finishing the last bit of welding on the hull.
npcs.repeat_text: Watch yourself around these ships, it can be dangerous if you're not careful.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 D,E SS Anne Waitress
npcs.meet_text: The SS Anne is always hiring if you fancy travelling the world.
npcs.repeat_text: We always have a lot of spare uniforms on hand as some staff land at a nice port and decide they don't want to go back to work again!

npcs.name: CH 3-6 D,E SS Anne Waiter
npcs.meet_text: I've only been a waiter around a week, they were short staffed so offered me a high pay.
npcs.repeat_text: I highly reccomend it as a career, but I don't know what I'll do after the ship returns back to Vermillion.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 E Blaine
npcs.meet_text: The name's Blaine. I was the gym leader on Cinnabar years ago before the volcano erupted. We moved to the Seafoam islands for a while but it was just never the same. I was the strongest Gym leader back then so take my strongest card.
npcs.repeat_text: The Cinnabar eruption wasn't the largest shock, we knew we were on a volcano but it was still devastating. Thankfully nobody was hurt but the island was lost almost entirely.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 E Woman Walking Neighbourhood
npcs.meet_text: Do you ever end up walking more than you thought you were going to?
npcs.repeat_text: I always end up walking further than I should.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 Sailor 2 Pier 1
npcs.meet_text: With the arrival of the SS Anne we're even busier than usual. We've never had this many tourists in the harbour at once.
npcs.repeat_text: Sigh.. I wish I could just on the SS Anne and sail away on it forever.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 D,E Maintenance Guy Blocking Forest
npcs.meet_text: Sorry, the forest is still closed off, we haven't been able to clear the area entirely yet. We were hoping to have all the work done before today so all the passengers of the SS Anne could go out and explore.
npcs.repeat_text: We're nearly done with it so it'll definitely be open tomorrow, my boss would kill me if we don't have it reopened before the SS Anne leaves again.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 D,E Car Park Guy
npcs.meet_text: Sorry, I can't let you into the car park unless you have car!
npcs.repeat_text: It's too dangerous to be wondering around on the road you know, I can't let any accidents happen under my watch.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 E Man Staring Out To Sea
npcs.meet_text: It's nearly time for my girlfriend to finish her shift.
npcs.repeat_text: I've got the slow cooker on so dinner will be all ready when we get home.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 D,E Juicebar Woman
npcs.meet_text: Hello! Can I interest you in any juice today?
npcs.repeat_text: Did you get lucky and find a coin this time?

npcs.name: CH 3-6 D,E Sailor Working On Dock
npcs.meet_text: *huff* I knew I'd be busy with the SS Anne arriving but *huff* I didn't think I'd be THIS busy....
npcs.repeat_text: *huff* *huff* The SS Anne only arrives once a year and it's always the harbour's busiest days.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 E Station Manager
npcs.meet_text: Good evening. The last train of the day will be departing shortly so please head through to the gate if you intend to catch it.
npcs.repeat_text: The trains here are always very punctual, they're never late.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 D,E Train Employee 2
npcs.meet_text: I'm been tasked with litter picking with the influx of tourist.
npcs.repeat_text: There's plenty of bins around so I don't why people don't use them.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 E Firebreather Darryl
npcs.meet_text: mMMMmm mMmMm MmmmMM MmMMmM mMMMmMmMm mMmMmMMm MMMmM mm mmMM MmmMMmM.
npcs.repeat_text: Sorry you caught me at a bad time I had a mouthful of fire fluid there.

npcs.name: CH 3-6 E Firebreather Kenneth
npcs.meet_text: We're good at what we do and we make it look easy but it's not.
npcs.repeat_text: It's very hard work this!

opponents.name: Gambler Mick
opponents.meet_text: All I need is a bit of luck, I let that decide my fate. If I battle enough then I'm bound to win some of them at least.
opponents.repeat_text: I'll be a lot luckier this time round.
opponents.first_win_text: Luck really wasn't on my side today...
opponents.rematch_win_text: I just need a little bit of luck that's all.
opponents.loss_text: Looks like luck wasn't on your side today.

opponents.name: Gardener Callum
opponents.meet_text: Wowee, it was a long day gardening today. I'm down for a match to let off some steam now.
opponents.repeat_text: I've got time for a rematch before my next shift.
opponents.first_win_text: I'm clearly too worn out from such a long shift.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'll win when I'm fully rested.
opponents.loss_text: Even after a hard days work I can still win!

opponents.name: Swimmer Jordan
opponents.meet_text: I love the water, it's so calm and warm but my cards always get wet! I need to dry them off.
opponents.repeat_text: My friend has just arrived from Kanto and we're spending the day swimming together, but I can take a break for a rematch.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Nothing like a good match and a long swim.
opponents.loss_text: Maybe you should work on your swimming...

opponents.name: Bug Catcher Alex
opponents.meet_text: Some people hate bugs but I love them! Do you love bugs too?
opponents.repeat_text: You just love bugs as much as I do then?
opponents.first_win_text: Maybe bugs aren't as good as I thought...
opponents.rematch_win_text: Me and my bugs will win one of these days!
opponents.loss_text: I knew bugs were the best!!

opponents.name: Hiker Matthew
opponents.meet_text: I've been hiking for hours and only just managed to reach the harbour and found everything is closed so now I have nothing to do for the evening.
opponents.repeat_text: I'll be hiking back again tomorrow, I hike all day every day!
opponents.first_win_text: I should have just called it a night...
opponents.rematch_win_text: I could do with a long hike to get over this loss.

opponents.name: Sailor Bob
opponents.meet_text: I'm all done preparing for the arrival of the SS Anne so there's not much to do now until morning.
opponents.repeat_text: There's still time before the SS Anne arrives.
opponents.first_win_text: I should at least pretend to do some work on the dock.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I won't have a lot of time to play when the ship docks.
opponents.loss_text: All this spare time has given me a chance to practice.

opponents.name: Bug Catcher Frankie
opponents.meet_text: Wow!!! The bugs here are so much cooler than what we have over in Viridian Forest!!
opponents.repeat_text: Seen any cool bug Pokemon around here since our last match?
opponents.first_win_text: My bugs clearly aren't as strong as the ones around here.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Hmm I wish I could get my hands on some of these bugs instead.
opponents.loss_text: Bug pokemon really aren't as weak as people think.

opponents.name: Garden Manager Louis
opponents.meet_text: I might be the garden manager but I do know how to have fun.
opponents.repeat_text: Look at how great the gardens look.
opponents.first_win_text: Even with all this sun I couldn't win.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Ever fancied being a gardener yourself?

opponents.name: Hiker Ben
opponents.meet_text: Well that's incredibly disappointing. I was hoping to have a trek through the forest but they've told me it's shut so I have nowhere to go now.
opponents.repeat_text: The forest has to be open soon surely.
opponents.first_win_text: Well that's another disappointment to my day.
opponents.loss_text: At least that's given me a nice little boost after the bad news.

opponents.name: Card Elder Hamish
opponents.meet_text: Back for the challenge then hey? Remember you'll need to defeat all 3 of us if you want to progress.
opponents.repeat_text: Very well, I always enjoy a good challenge!
opponents.first_win_text: Well done, that was quite the battle. Take my medal and continue forth.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Battling like this makes me feel young again.
opponents.loss_text: Don't be disheartened, the rain will always stop.

opponents.name: Card Elder Rayne
opponents.meet_text: Hoh Hoh, are you ready to feel the torrent? If you win I'll give you a medal to prove your triumph.
opponents.repeat_text: Hoh Hoh! I enjoyed the battle that much I'd also like another!
opponents.first_win_text: Congratulations on your win. You've earned this medal and my respect.
opponents.rematch_win_text: Come back any time and battle us old folk.
opponents.loss_text: Don't be disheartened, the rain will always stop.

opponents.name: Card Elder Waverly
opponents.meet_text: Are you ready to take me on then? If you win then you'll do well in the Gym Hero Challenge.
opponents.repeat_text: Up for another round then? Happy to oblige.
opponents.first_win_text: Well well well, what a jolly good play! You've earned this.
opponents.rematch_win_text: We've been winning and losing for so long it's always fun either way.
opponents.loss_text: When you fail, get up and try again.

opponents.name: Battlegirl Sofia
opponents.meet_text: This beach is a great spot to train both my martial arts and my card skills.
opponents.repeat_text: Want to join in with my training?
opponents.first_win_text: A loss is always a good chance to improve.
opponents.rematch_win_text: I'm going to keep on training.
opponents.loss_text: I rarely lose when I've trained properly.
